title: Playtest panel + rubric calibration
description: Score the same playtest evidence blind across three lenses, then let a teacher model critique the assessors until their reads agree enough to act on.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-game-01
  title: Playtest panel + rubric calibration
  description: Score the same playtest evidence blind across three lenses, then let a teacher model critique
    the assessors until their reads agree enough to act on.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Turn playtest sessions into design decisions the team can trust, with assessor agreement
    demonstrated before any system is changed.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Playtest sessions and design intent
      summary: Playtest sessions and design intent
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - session_recordings
              - telemetry
              - design_intent
              - agreement_threshold
            properties:
              session_recordings: {}
              telemetry: {}
              design_intent: {}
              agreement_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-01
      name: Systems read of the sessions
      summary: Blind assessment 1; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Systems designer building mechanics, economies, and progression that hold up under play.
      prompt: You are a Game Systems Designer. You specify mechanics, resource economies, and progression
        curves with the intended player experience and the failure state of each system written down,
        and you look for the degenerate strategy before players do. You separate a system that is difficult
        from one that is opaque, because players abandon the second and talk about the first.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-02
      name: Behavior legibility read
      summary: Blind assessment 2; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Behavior designer specifying agent behavior that reads as intentional to a player.
      prompt: 'You are an NPC Behavior Designer. You specify behavior trees, utility scoring, and perception
        rules so the resulting behavior is legible — a player should be able to infer what the NPC noticed
        and why it acted. You treat unreadable competence as a bug: an enemy that outplays a player invisibly
        is experienced as cheating, not as difficulty.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-05
      name: Player research read
      summary: Blind assessment 3; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Researcher designing playtests and reading player behavior honestly.
      prompt: You are a Playtest Research Lead. You design playtests with specific questions, observable
        measures, and a protocol that avoids leading the participant, and you separate what players did
        from what they said about it. You report the finding that contradicts the design intent first,
        because that is the finding the test existed to surface.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - clinical-review
          - research
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-panel
      kind: group
      name: Blind playtest assessment panel
      summary: Every assessor runs on the same evidence in parallel; the group exits only once all member
        results are aggregated.
      config:
        members:
          - n-assess1
          - n-assess2
          - n-assess3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: n-teacher
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Rubric calibration
      summary: Critique the assessors against the rubric — this scores the graders, not the work.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the calibration teacher for this playtest panel. Critique the assessors against
        the rubric: where did two assessors read the same player behavior into different conclusions,
        where did an assessor infer intent from behavior the evidence does not support, and where is the
        rubric itself ambiguous? Score the assessors, not the players.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: n-agreement
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score inter-assessor agreement
      summary: Evaluate inter-assessor agreement per rubric dimension and evidence sufficiency behind
        each finding.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against inter-assessor agreement per rubric dimension and evidence
        sufficiency behind each finding. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-calibrated
      kind: condition
      name: Calibrated?
      summary: Route on agreement.passed.
      config:
        expression: agreement.passed
        branches:
          - label: Calibrated
            when: 'true'
          - label: Not calibrated
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-recalibrate
      kind: loop
      name: Recalibrate until assessors agree
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-panel
          - n-teacher
          - n-agreement
          - n-calibrated
        exitCondition: inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Design lead accepts the calibrated findings
      summary: Pause for the design lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Playtest panel + rubric calibration deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-panel
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-2
      from: n-panel
      to: n-teacher
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-3
      from: n-teacher
      to: n-agreement
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-4
      from: n-agreement
      to: n-calibrated
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-5
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-6
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-recalibrate
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-7
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-game-01-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
